notes: Simulated garment, with hardware and all reference objects removed. Actual pinned ONNX model inference, not invented numbers.
Known synthetic flat waist: 41.0 cm. Compare it with the model guess. This demonstrates model scale error.
Experimental metric-depth guess. No error interval is established for real garments; actual error can be large. No fit decision should use these centimetres.
Camera focal length comes from photo metadata when present, otherwise an explicit field-of-view assumption.
A consistent floor plane or agreeing photos cannot detect shared model scale bias.
The garment must be flat. Depth and outline checks cannot prove this.
Silhouette landmarks can miss overlapped crotch seams. Check every line.
